features.name: Martial Training
features.desc: You gain proficiency with Medium armor, Shields, and Martial weapons.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.desc: A creature with your Bardic Inspiration die can add it to a weapon damage roll or, as a Reaction, to its AC against one attack.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: War Magic
features.desc: After you take the Attack action, you can cast one Bard spell as a Bonus Action.
